subject.title: bug: withAllowedHostname only updates allowedHostnames, not hostnameAllowlist — breaks navigate with non-empty hostnameAllowlist

question: Should OpenClaw accept the linked PR's scoped exact-host CDP control-plane exception as the approved fix for this browser SSRF hostnameAllowlist bug?
rationale: The source-level bug is clear, but the fix changes a browser SSRF control boundary and current tests encode the stricter behavior, so maintainer security intent is needed before merge.

options.title: Accept scoped CDP control fix
options.body: Land the linked PR after redacted live browser proof confirms restrictive hostnameAllowlist navigation works while non-loopback and page-navigation checks remain strict.

options.title: Keep strict hostnameAllowlist behavior
options.body: Require users to include the CDP host in `hostnameAllowlist` and update docs/tests so the operator burden is explicit.

options.title: Defer to broader SSRF design
options.body: Keep this issue open behind https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/38931 if maintainers want a broader private-network policy redesign before changing CDP behavior.

recommendation.title: Accept scoped CDP control fix
recommendation.body: Land the linked PR after redacted live browser proof confirms restrictive hostnameAllowlist navigation works while non-loopback and page-navigation checks remain strict.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the central helper refactor and have the clearest sampled history on the implicated browser SSRF helper boundary.
